subject: How do I get raw intensity data for all the probes

messages.author: 0ddb2ed74ec98662
messages.subject: How do I get raw intensity data for all the probes
parts:
Hi Henrik

I would like to get the raw intensity data for all the probes of a
particular probe.

Say for example I read the CEL files using the function below

library(aroma.affymetrix)
cs <- AffymetrixCelSet$fromName("PMCIORIG",chipType =
"Mapping50K_Xba240")


How can I get all the signals from the 40 probes of SNP_A-1704371


Thanks a lot

Joshy

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] How do I get raw intensity data for all the probes
parts:
On Thu, May 15, 2008 at 1:33 AM, joshy <gjo...@gmail.com> wrote:
>
> Hi Henrik
>
> I would like to get the raw intensity data for all the probes of a
> particular probe.
>
> Say for example I read the CEL files using the function below
>
> library(aroma.affymetrix)
> cs <- AffymetrixCelSet$fromName("PMCIORIG",chipType =
> "Mapping50K_Xba240")
>
>
> How can I get all the signals from the 40 probes of SNP_A-1704371

cdf <- getCdf(cs);
unit <- indexOf(cdf, "SNP_A-1704371");
y <- readUnits(cs, units=unit);
str(y);
List of 1
$ SNP_A-1704371:List of 4
..$ A:List of 1
.. ..$ intensities: num [1:10, 1:6] 658 788 1018 777 1038 ...
..$ G:List of 1
.. ..$ intensities: num [1:10, 1:6] 3110 623 1571 2776 1304 ...
..$ A:List of 1
.. ..$ intensities: num [1:10, 1:6] 1340 1104 548 1116 988 ...
..$ G:List of 1
.. ..$ intensities: num [1:10, 1:6] 1555 6337 1498 7602 8632 ...

There you get the four groups - Allele A and Allele B on the forward
and the reverse strand - each containing 10 probe signals across, in
my example, six arrays. The array dimension is always the last
dimension in any matrix/array returned by aroma.affymetrix.

To get data for a particular array/file, do:

cf <- getFile(cs, 2);
y <- readUnits(cf, units=unit);
str(y);
List of 1
$ SNP_A-1704371:List of 4
..$ A:List of 1
.. ..$ intensities: num [1:10] 671 636 906 681 627 803 610 362 705 705
..$ G:List of 1
.. ..$ intensities: num [1:10] 2797 520 864 3273 1001 ...
..$ A:List of 1
.. ..$ intensities: num [1:10] 596 1200 509 1127 1172 ...
..$ G:List of 1
.. ..$ intensities: num [1:10] 1657 9769 2546 12732 13081 ...

Hope this helps

Henrik
